title: Similar - Foundry Feedstock Quote
goal: Parse a noisy binary STL of a scanned casting, isolate the largest connected component, extract its alloy code from the triangle attribute bytes, and compute a feedstock quote from provided density and cost tables.
skillBenefitRationale: `mesh-analysis` is the only critical shipped skill because the task depends on binary STL parsing, connected-component cleanup, largest-part selection, and attribute-byte extraction before any pricing math is possible.
